about: flagship/pq-session/v1 (docs/architecture-v2/pq-suites.md §13). DRAFT, pending Q01 external cryptographic review. Generated by tools/pq-session-vectors.ts; TS, Rust, Swift and Kotlin check every case. Signatures are deterministic (ML-DSA rnd = 0^32); production signing is hedged. The responder trusts the parties named in `responderTrusts`; times: hello at `now`, accept at now+100, finish at now+200, complete at now+300, records at now+400.
